meta.title: Education and training providers for 14-19 and adult skills (GIAS)
meta.publisher: Department for Education - Get Information About Schools
meta.quality: Administrative register maintained by DfE from establishments and LAs; status, type and address are reliable, but pupil numbers and % FSM are copied from the last school census (CensusDate attribute) and some fields are self-reported by establishments.
meta.limitations: Open establishments in Bedford, Central Bedfordshire and Luton that are secondary, all-through, 16-19, UTC/studio, FE/sixth-form college, HEI, alternative provision (age 15+), special schools with post-16 (statutory high age >16) and independent schools with 16+ provision; plus FE and sixth-form colleges in neighbouring LAs within 25 km of the site. Middle schools (9-13, Bedford/Central Bedfordshire three-tier system) and primaries are excluded. Pupil numbers and % FSM are blank for FE colleges, HEIs and many independents (not collected via the school census) and FE college counts are a single head-office record - campuses are not separate rows, so the point is the registered address. GIAS no longer publishes Ofsted grades (ofsted_rating is null; use Ofsted management information). Independent training providers and employer apprenticeship providers are NOT included: no open download links UKPRN to delivery location. Distances are straight-line from the site (52.087N, 0.516W); OSGB36->WGS84 by Helmert (~2 m).

indicators.label: Pupils on roll (school census)
indicators.description: Number of pupils from the latest school census held in GIAS (NumberOfPupils); one point per provider with attrs (urn, type, phase, age range, sixth form, % FSM, LA, postcode, website, dist_km).

indicators.label: % pupils eligible for free school meals
indicators.description: PercentageFSM from GIAS (census-based) - deprivation marker for the provider's intake.

indicators.label: Number of open providers by category
indicators.description: Count of open providers in each Bedfordshire LA by category (breakdown).
